title: Platelet count and volume do not establish incremental prediction of soluble transferrin receptor in nonanemic women: a two-sample NHANES test
abstract: Adding platelet-count and mean-platelet-volume curves to conventional red-cell, ferritin, inflammation and demographic measures gave a small target log-sTfR MSE gain of 0.00073790 (95% source/target PSU-refit interval -0.00249037 to 0.00282428) in 932 nonanemic adult women. Incremental prediction was not established in the independently sampled NHANES2005–2006 target after fitting NHANES2003–2004 (n=881). Reduced mean bias accounts for the point gain; centered residual error worsened. No new useful biomarker or clinical benefit is established.
